messages.content: {"task": "Translate EVERY supplied row into Russian. Return JSON only: {\"rows\":[{\"source_id\":\"exact supplied id\",\"target\":\"complete Russian translation\"}]}. Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Les Misérables", "unit": 222, "heading": "XXI ON DEVRAIT TOUJOURS COMMENCER PAR ARRÊTER LES VICTIMES", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr81-u222-r0030", "target": "Тенардьесса укрепилась в одном из углов у окна, и это она издала рёв.", "source_sha256": "7343f29c9c7b5642b1502699d57d158007ac213f4e4d33fae00b3c998181fa6c", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u222-r0030", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "ce4250fd32e3b67d601332c751ad63c2d8c940b98a9005aefdfa214e4a590669"}, {"source_id": "fr81-u222-r0031", "target": "Городские сержанты и агенты отступили.", "source_sha256": "dd31fb1d5dfea4b298e17c7a3d3239fbbe8cabc41339c483decb7249031fb71c", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u222-r0031", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "268ac662c22c372a93372754739b806e8b6d0979cd4ad27be1bc3fa58fe22643"}], "source_language": "French", "part": 3, "book": 8, "chapter": 21, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr81-u222-r0032", "tag": "prose", "text": "Elle avait jeté son châle et gardé son chapeau ; son mari, accroupi derrière elle, disparaissait presque sous le châle tombé, et elle le couvrait de son corps, élevant le pavé des deux mains au-dessus de sa tête avec le balancement d’une géante qui va lancer un rocher.", "sha256": "896fb97f405e766e1426d8ceea35f52b8e52503aab899bf4f7e3b7c26f40f22b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0033", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Gare ! cria-t-elle.", "sha256": "c9116b38af1caeaa88690675c8c7db9ecb74bf3825601aaee9fb397fd811d00e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0034", "tag": "prose", "text": "Tous se refoulèrent vers le corridor. Un large vide se fit au milieu du galetas.", "sha256": "8ba1f539d04344e3d1751fe6a11a2c82688ddb0a656704b9696b52db67dad298", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0035", "tag": "prose", "text": "La Thénardier jeta un regard aux bandits qui s’étaient laissé garrotter et murmura d’un accent guttural et rauque :", "sha256": "c04221bf73a09e635d36daeb8029dbf75db634cad22ea5c044f1eac94ff3d367", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0036", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Les lâches !", "sha256": "02e34e0be49c3aab8b6a03a4ab042822fedf66de843005f7af067cf80b429886", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0037", "tag": "prose", "text": "Javert sourit et s’avança dans l’espace vide que la Thénardier couvait de ses deux prunelles.", "sha256": "5a4f77380cc4c7a5d5b9529274ee3cc591cf0f7dad971c45c8b13b573ddda0f9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0038", "tag": "prose", "text": "— N’approche pas, va-t’en, cria-t-elle, ou je t’écroule !", "sha256": "99d13ed67ec6233085710ba89c2b0776652264ca1919d6baebe6da5c74578098", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0039", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Quel grenadier ! fit Javert ; la mère ! tu as de la barbe comme un homme, mais j’ai des griffes comme une femme.", "sha256": "54382839fab4c1adc15be1cff758ff76a5981294403a87444d9380f286a57262", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0040", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et il continua de s’avancer.", "sha256": "ad6c0fe0c7164b845305c66268aba1a5026f7166afa26ed28cf78c5e599ee601", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0041", "tag": "prose", "text": "La Thénardier, échevelée et terrible, écarta les jambes, se cambra en arrière et jeta éperdument le pavé à la tête de Javert. Javert se courba. Le pavé passa au-dessus de lui, heurta la muraille du fond dont il fit tomber un vaste plâtras et revint, en ricochant d’angle en angle à travers le bouge, heureusement presque vide, mourir sur les talons de Javert.", "sha256": "85885cd1b2f0ecacb0038dfae1833deab65716a2804d8068e399a25a8dc0bc68", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0042", "tag": "prose", "text": "Au même instant Javert arrivait au couple Thénardier. Une de ses larges mains s’abattit sur l’épaule de la femme et l’autre sur la tête du mari.", "sha256": "692f93983072ea651a0c7d922e2dd50a906be08a26528bb42c2d2bd6d113ee01", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0043", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Les poucettes ! cria-t-il.", "sha256": "b8db8435136b1c7f2c7007469f4c12017e14406324b9ba86ef734d8170297dac", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0044", "tag": "prose", "text": "Les hommes de police rentrèrent en foule, et en quelques secondes l’ordre de Javert fut exécuté.", "sha256": "a027b9b56c61711d0275aca7f0eb50fdf6f38a2affb4dded54acbd176fd100d8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0045", "tag": "prose", "text": "La Thénardier, brisée, regarda ses mains garrottées et celles de son mari, se laissa tomber à terre, et s’écria en pleurant :", "sha256": "2d92572c7ed1e25a431c062ce940d1968debc132616b028f1c4a3f21e0e9d9b3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0046", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Mes filles !", "sha256": "39d74515d47152cecfe689bb56e6f22b2d938cd3b56feb6171216971add6385d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0047", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Elles sont à l’ombre, dit Javert.", "sha256": "86a47d82d5c41ff5fd97b9936fc48d80c8bf3f310a88201103043b75ad68620e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0048", "tag": "prose", "text": "Cependant les agents avaient avisé l’ivrogne endormi derrière la porte et le secouaient. Il s’éveilla en balbutiant :", "sha256": "33dbe087e92558a6d52dc2de6c27da7d973975e22f712b76d4d4d0e65847646b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0049", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Est-ce fini, Jondrette ?", "sha256": "8bc180f8bdd2c93e5f67bee0911d1d7a5bfbbb7ff76ea4bbe71a936e247af55a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0050", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oui, répondit Javert.", "sha256": "b8a859ad51b5bd7b8ae37cb04d37a1944188b2f617ab0b73c462e23abc973023", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0051", "tag": "prose", "text": "Les six bandits garrottés étaient debout ; du reste, ils avaient encore leurs mines de spectres ; trois barbouillés de noir, trois masqués.", "sha256": "26b77d42d4c8677c1f39b9d36a1a2da5068c7384bc17849c9320a56e22c4f1ad", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0052", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Gardez vos masques, dit Javert.", "sha256": "7ea319e9e6a0a081e8d2486fb8b0ba79e87bccf56d68c55381ee035ff902c566", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0053", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et, les passant en revue avec le regard d’un Frédéric II à la parade de Potsdam, il dit aux trois « fumistes » :", "sha256": "6371a0a8c29126c7a56403d09a1405f41fdcc730bcc2bd8b1c584b12adeead3d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0054", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Bonjour, Bigrenaille. Bonjour, Brujon. Bonjour, Deux-Milliards.", "sha256": "8c2f2f2b2848831658ca85282fee3bc8268dd17c2a66bd4334c1afbd15444b4d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0055", "tag": "prose", "text": "Puis, se tournant vers les trois masques, il dit à l’homme au merlin :", "sha256": "ac38a601901c8acea7b976fdd58b08d9bec3f6abe3b1b076060a6f0b70d34315", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0056", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Bonjour, Gueulemer.", "sha256": "9eec9d76ce5c01a56a81adbb4c625a84dfd16df83dc2c8449b1d4ebf63a85db4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0057", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et à l’homme à la trique :", "sha256": "24f7901289a1a71007c8008263d37f1e4d8f1b78e5a44d9fcf8722f689e2c0ca", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0058", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Bonjour, Babet.", "sha256": "05327a47e0fb048037f9d9e48ad553de27dff3961aec3f491a02f7d023b25608", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0059", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et au ventriloque :", "sha256": "c216d8ae5f736fced15fb53732165975048b8cda9fb61ccb4695fe47d18ff16b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0060", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Salut, Claquesous.", "sha256": "18d2568d86d7d2345a3e40e0727073a2b797ca92333e6dc25f68f7ca66f59620", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0061", "tag": "prose", "text": "En ce moment, il aperçut le prisonnier des bandits qui, depuis l’entrée des agents de police, n’avait pas prononcé une parole et tenait sa tête baissée.", "sha256": "e51fe195ed3e571dc3d07c6f4d5450b94d36a7ac1c5caba8c3461bd99e4eac91", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0062", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Déliez monsieur, dit Javert, et que personne ne sorte !", "sha256": "260720c133c96fe1e869ef9ce3de5130e0646803780bc70ab32601bc0c726c2e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u222-r0063", "tag": "prose", "text": "Cela dit, il s’assit souverainement devant la table, où étaient restées la chandelle et l’écritoire, tira un papier timbré de sa poche et commença son procès-verbal.", "sha256": "3fa5215021c05d4f3ed8880a8964fe71a7bb5bf3eb07fc7bc9786bcf6ce1505c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
